title: Toroidal closure of the main web graph
description: Abstract edges and oriented face boundary walks recovered from the manuscript TikZ drawing after identifying opposite sides. This records the toroidal closure, not the full labeled annular morphism.

provenance.method: Vertex letters are those assigned to coordinates in Figure 7 TikZ. Straight/curved paths are traced between joint vertices; paired cut endpoints are joined. Face letters follow the fills. The remaining face walk is obtained from the unused directed edges.
provenance.status: Companion transcription from the authors source, not an independently proved graph theorem.

face_boundary_walk_convention: Each list is cyclic; append its first vertex to close it. Repeated vertices and repeated undirected edges are intentional. Each directed edge occurs once over all listed walks.
limitations: No edge thicknesses, open input/output boundary, or six-map presentation are encoded.
The same abstract graph without its face walks would not specify the embedding.
Face g repeats vertices F and N and traverses edge FN in both directions.
These data do not identify the graph with the Heawood graph or assert a web-calculus equality.
